    public function install(
        Request $request,
        Server $server,
    ): JsonResponse {
        $provider = null;
        $package = null;
        $lock = null;
        $token = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $progressToken = '';

        try {
            $lock = $this->installationLock()->acquire(
                $this->lockKey($server),
                $token,
            );

            $this->clearCancelFlag($this->lockKey($server));

            $source = $this->installationSource($request);

            $progressToken = $this->progressToken($request);

            $progress = $this->installProgressStore();

            $progress->set($progressToken, [
                'phase' => 'starting',
                'percent' => 1,
                'indeterminate' => false,
            ]);

            $downloader = $this->downloader();

            $downloader->setCancelChecker(
                fn (): bool => $this->wasCancelled(
                    $this->lockKey($server),
                ),
            );

            $lastLockTouch = 0.0;

            $lastPercent = 0.0;

            $downloader->setProgressCallback(
                static function (
                    ?int $downloadedBytes,
                    ?int $totalBytes,
                ) use (
                    $progress,
                    $progressToken,
                    $lock,
                    &$lastLockTouch,
                    &$lastPercent,
                ): void {
                    $now = microtime(true);

                    if (($now - $lastLockTouch) >= 2.0) {
                        $lastLockTouch = $now;

                        // Keep the install lock alive so a long download is
                        // never reclaimed as stale while it is still running.
                        @touch($lock);
                    }

                    $percent = 40;

                    if (
                        $totalBytes !== null
                        && $totalBytes > 0
                        && $downloadedBytes !== null
                    ) {
                        $percent = (int) floor(
                            min(1.0, $downloadedBytes / $totalBytes) * 85,
                        );
                    }

                    // Re-anchoring between acquisition phases (e.g. the
                    // mrpack archive vs the parsed index footprint) can make
                    // the raw fraction dip momentarily. Clamp to the highest
                    // percent seen so far so the bar is strictly monotonic.
                    $percent = (int) max($lastPercent, $percent);

                    $lastPercent = $percent;

                    $progress->set($progressToken, [
                        'phase' => 'download',
                        'percent' => $percent,
                        'indeterminate' => $totalBytes === null || $totalBytes <= 0,
                        'downloaded_bytes' => $downloadedBytes,
                        'total_bytes' => $totalBytes,
                    ]);
                },
            );

            $provider = $this->providerRegistry($downloader)->resolve($source);

            $package = $provider->getPackage($source);

            $progress->set($progressToken, [
                'phase' => 'preparing',
                'percent' => 88,
                'indeterminate' => false,
            ]);

            $target = $this->serverTarget($server);

            $orchestrator = $this->orchestrator(
                $target,
                static function (
                    int $deployedFiles,
                    int $totalFiles,
                ) use (
                    $progress,
                    $progressToken,
                    $lock,
                    &$lastLockTouch,
                ): void {
                    $now = microtime(true);

                    if (($now - $lastLockTouch) >= 2.0) {
                        $lastLockTouch = $now;

                        @touch($lock);
                    }

                    $percent = 88 + (int) floor(
                        ($totalFiles > 0 ? $deployedFiles / $totalFiles : 0)
                            * 12,
                    );

                    $progress->set($progressToken, [
                        'phase' => 'deploy',
                        'percent' => $percent,
                        'indeterminate' => false,
                        'deployed_files' => $deployedFiles,
                        'total_files' => $totalFiles,
                    ]);
                },
                fn (): bool => $this->wasCancelled(
                    $this->lockKey($server),
                ),
            );

            $result = $orchestrator->install(
                archivePath: $package->archivePath,
            );

            $progress->set($progressToken, [
                'phase' => 'complete',
                'percent' => 100,
                'indeterminate' => false,
            ]);

            try {
                $metadata = $this->installMetadata(
                    $provider,
                    $package->source,
                );

                $record = $this->buildInstallRecord(
                    server: $server,
                    installedSource: $package->source,
                    metadata: $metadata,
                    result: $result,
                );

                $this->store()->save($record);
            } catch (Throwable $exception) {
                // The deployment itself succeeded, so a failure while recording
                // it (metadata lookup, record store) must not leave newly
                // deployed files stranded without a record. Best-effort remove
                // exactly the files this install created.
                $this->rollbackDeployedFiles($server, $result);

                throw $exception;
            }

            return response()->json([
                'data' => [
                    'total_files' => $result->totalFiles(),
                    'created' => $result->createdCount(),
                    'overwritten' => $result->overwrittenCount(),
                    'backed_up' => $result->backupCount(),
                    'record_id' => $record->id,
                ],
            ]);
        } catch (InstallationCancelledException $exception) {
            if ($progressToken !== '') {
                $this->installProgressStore()->set($progressToken, [
                    ...($this->installProgressStore()
                        ->get($progressToken) ?? []),
                    'phase' => 'cancelled',
                    'indeterminate' => false,
                    'message' => $exception->getMessage(),
                ]);
            }

            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Installation cancelled.',
            ], 409);
        } catch (InstallationLockedException $exception) {
            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Another installation is already running for this server. Please wait and try again.',
            ], 503);
        } catch (InvalidArgumentException $exception) {
            return response()->json([
                'error' => $exception->getMessage(),
            ], 422);
        } catch (UnsupportedModpackPackageException $exception) {
            return response()->json([
                'error' => $exception->getMessage(),
            ], 422);
        } catch (WingsConnectionException $exception) {
            if ($progressToken !== '') {
                $this->installProgressStore()->set($progressToken, [
                    ...($this->installProgressStore()
                        ->get($progressToken) ?? []),
                    'phase' => 'failed',
                    'indeterminate' => false,
                    'message' => 'Unable to reach the server node. The installation failed.',
                ]);
            }

            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Unable to reach the server node. Please try again later.',
            ], 503);
        } catch (WingsHttpException $exception) {
            if ($progressToken !== '') {
                $this->installProgressStore()->set($progressToken, [
                    ...($this->installProgressStore()
                        ->get($progressToken) ?? []),
                    'phase' => 'failed',
                    'indeterminate' => false,
                    'message' => 'The server node could not complete the operation. The installation failed.',
                ]);
            }

            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'The server node could not complete the operation. Please try again later.',
            ], 503);
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            report($exception);

            if ($progressToken !== '') {
                $lastState = $this->installProgressStore()
                    ->get($progressToken);

                $this->installProgressStore()->set($progressToken, [
                    ...($lastState ?? []),
                    'phase' => 'failed',
                    'indeterminate' => false,
                    'message' => 'The installation failed.',
                ]);
            }

            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Unable to install the modpack.',
            ], 500);
        } finally {
            if ($lock !== null) {
                try {
                    $this->installationLock()->release($lock, $token);
                } catch (Throwable) {
                    // Releasing the lock must never mask the installation
                    // outcome; stale-lock handling covers leftover locks.
                }
            }

            if ($provider !== null && $package !== null) {
                $provider->cleanup($package);
            }

            $this->clearCancelFlag($this->lockKey($server));
        }
    }

    public function installedModpacks(
        Request $request,
        Server $server,
    ): JsonResponse {
        try {
            $records = $this->store()->all((string) $server->uuid);

            $target = $this->serverTarget($server);

            $verifier = new InstallIntegrityVerifier();

            $data = [];

            foreach ($records as $record) {
                if ($verifier->isCompletelyGone($record, $target)) {
                    $this->store()->delete(
                        (string) $server->uuid,
                        $record->id,
                    );

                    continue;
                }

                $item = $record->toArray();

                $missing = $verifier->missingFiles($record, $target);

                $item['integrity'] = [
                    'status' => $missing === []
                        ? 'ok'
                        : 'degraded',
                    'missing' => $missing,
                    'missing_count' => count($missing),
                ];

                $data[] = $item;
            }

            return response()->json([
                'data' => $data,
            ]);
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            report($exception);

            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Unable to load the installed modpacks.',
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    public function uninstall(
        Request $request,
        Server $server,
        string $id,
    ): JsonResponse {
        $lock = null;
        $token = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));

        try {
            $id = $this->validateRecordId($id);

            $lock = $this->installationLock()->acquire(
                $this->lockKey($server),
                $token,
            );

            $record = $this->store()->find(
                (string) $server->uuid,
                $id,
            );

            if ($record === null) {
                return response()->json([
                    'error' => 'The installed modpack was not found.',
                ], 404);
            }

            if ($record->status !== InstallRecord::STATUS_INSTALLED) {
                return response()->json([
                    'error' => 'The installed modpack is not in an active state.',
                ], 409);
            }

            $target = $this->serverTarget($server);

            $outcome = (new OwnershipRemover($target))->remove(
                $record->ownedFiles(),
            );

            if ($outcome['errors'] !== []) {
                report(new RuntimeException(
                    'Modpack uninstall failed to remove owned files: '
                        . implode('; ', $outcome['errors']),
                ));

                return response()->json([
                    'error' => 'Unable to fully uninstall the modpack. No files were partially removed from the record.',
                ], 500);
            }

            $this->store()->delete((string) $server->uuid, $id);

            return response()->json([
                'data' => [
                    'id' => $record->id,
                    'display_name' => $record->displayName,
                    'version' => $record->version,
                    'removed' => count($outcome['deleted']),
                    'missing' => count($outcome['missing']),
                ],
            ]);
        } catch (InstallationLockedException $exception) {
            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Another installation operation is already running for this server. Please wait and try again.',
            ], 503);
        } catch (InvalidArgumentException $exception) {
            return response()->json([
                'error' => $exception->getMessage(),
            ], 422);
        } catch (WingsConnectionException $exception) {
            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Unable to reach the server node. Please try again later.',
            ], 503);
        } catch (WingsHttpException $exception) {
            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'The server node could not complete the operation. Please try again later.',
            ], 503);
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            report($exception);

            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Unable to uninstall the modpack.',
            ], 500);
        } finally {
            if ($lock !== null) {
                try {
                    $this->installationLock()->release($lock, $token);
                } catch (Throwable) {
                    // Releasing the lock must never mask the outcome.
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public function updateModpack(
        Request $request,
        Server $server,
        string $id,
    ): JsonResponse {
        $lock = null;
        $provider = null;
        $package = null;
        $token = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));

        try {
            $id = $this->validateRecordId($id);

            $lock = $this->installationLock()->acquire(
                $this->lockKey($server),
                $token,
            );

            $record = $this->store()->find(
                (string) $server->uuid,
                $id,
            );

            if ($record === null) {
                return response()->json([
                    'error' => 'The installed modpack was not found.',
                ], 404);
            }

            if ($record->status !== InstallRecord::STATUS_INSTALLED) {
                return response()->json([
                    'error' => 'The installed modpack is not in an active state.',
                ], 409);
            }

            $provider = $this->providerRegistry()->resolve($record->source);

            $latestBase = $this->latestBaseSource($record->source);

            $package = $provider->getPackage($latestBase);

            $metadata = $this->installMetadata(
                $provider,
                $package->source,
            );

            if ($metadata !== null && $metadata->version !== ''
                && $metadata->version === $record->version
            ) {
                return response()->json([
                    'error' => 'The modpack is already up to date.',
                ], 409);
            }

            $target = $this->serverTarget($server);

            $orchestrator = $this->orchestrator($target);

            $result = $orchestrator->install(
                archivePath: $package->archivePath,
            );

            $updated = $this->buildInstallRecord(
                server: $server,
                installedSource: $package->source,
                metadata: $metadata,
                result: $result,
                existingRecord: $record,
            );

            $this->store()->save($updated);

            return response()->json([
                'data' => [
                    'id' => $updated->id,
                    'display_name' => $updated->displayName,
                    'previous_version' => $record->version,
                    'version' => $updated->version,
                    'total_files' => $result->totalFiles(),
                    'created' => $result->createdCount(),
                    'overwritten' => $result->overwrittenCount(),
                    'backed_up' => $result->backupCount(),
                ],
            ]);
        } catch (InstallationLockedException $exception) {
            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Another installation operation is already running for this server. Please wait and try again.',
            ], 503);
        } catch (InvalidArgumentException $exception) {
            if (
                $provider instanceof ManualDownloadProvider
                && $record !== null
            ) {
                try {
                    $manualDownload = $provider->manualDownloadInfoFor(
                        $this->latestBaseSource($record->source),
                    );
                } catch (Throwable) {
                    $manualDownload = null;
                }

                if ($manualDownload !== null) {
                    return response()->json([
                        'error' => $exception->getMessage(),
                        'manual_download' => $manualDownload,
                    ], 422);
                }
            }

            return response()->json([
                'error' => $exception->getMessage(),
            ], 422);
        } catch (WingsConnectionException $exception) {
            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Unable to reach the server node. Please try again later.',
            ], 503);
        } catch (WingsHttpException $exception) {
            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'The server node could not complete the operation. Please try again later.',
            ], 503);
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            report($exception);

            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Unable to update the modpack.',
            ], 500);
        } finally {
            if ($lock !== null) {
                try {
                    $this->installationLock()->release($lock, $token);
                } catch (Throwable) {
                    // Releasing the lock must never mask the outcome.
                }
            }

            if ($provider !== null && $package !== null) {
                $provider->cleanup($package);
            }
        }
    }

        $provider = null;

            $id = $this->validateRecordId($id);

            return response()->json([
                'data' => [
                    'id' => $record->id,
                    'display_name' => $record->displayName,
                    'version' => $record->version,
                    'restored' => $result->createdCount(),
                    'requested' => count($missing),
                ],
            ]);
        } catch (InstallationLockedException $exception) {
            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Another installation operation is already running for this server. Please wait and try again.',
            ], 503);
        } catch (InvalidArgumentException $exception) {
            if (
                $provider instanceof ManualDownloadProvider
                && $record !== null
            ) {
                try {
                    $manualDownload = $provider->manualDownloadInfoFor(
                        $record->source,
                    );
                } catch (Throwable) {
                    $manualDownload = null;
                }

                if ($manualDownload !== null) {
                    return response()->json([
                        'error' => $exception->getMessage(),
                        'manual_download' => $manualDownload,

                }

            return response()->json([
                'error' => $exception->getMessage(),
            ], 422);

            return response()->json([
                'error' => $exception->getMessage(),
            ], 422);
        } catch (WingsConnectionException $exception) {
            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Unable to reach the server node. Please try again later.',
            ], 503);
        } catch (WingsHttpException $exception) {
            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'The server node could not complete the operation. Please try again later.',
            ], 503);
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            report($exception);

            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Unable to restore the missing modpack files.',
            ], 500);
        } finally {
            if ($lock !== null) {
                try {
                    $this->installationLock()->release($lock, $token);
                } catch (Throwable) {
                    // Releasing the lock must never mask the outcome.
                }
            }

            if ($provider !== null && $package !== null) {
                $provider->cleanup($package);
            }
        }
    }

    private function installationSource(
        Request $request,
    ): string {
        $sourceValue = $request->input('source');

        if (!is_string($sourceValue) || trim($sourceValue) === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                'The source parameter is required.',
            );
        }

        $source = trim($sourceValue);

        if (strlen($source) > 1024) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                'The source parameter is too long.',
            );
        }

        return $source;
    }

    private function catalogQuery(
        Request $request,
    ): CatalogSearchQuery {
        $provider = $this->paramString(
            $request,
            'provider',
            CatalogSearchQuery::DEFAULT_PROVIDER,
            32,
            '/^[a-z0-9-]{1,32}$/',
        );

        $query = $this->paramString(
            $request,
            'query',
            null,
            CatalogSearchQuery::MAX_QUERY_LENGTH,
        );

        $gameVersions = $this->paramList(
            $request,
            'game_versions',
            CatalogSearchQuery::VERSION_PATTERN,
        );

        $loaders = $this->paramList(
            $request,
            'loaders',

    private function catalogVersionQuery(

            return $default;
        }

        if (!is_string($value)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                $this->invalidParameterMessage($key),
            );
        }

        $value = trim($value);

        if ($value === '') {

        if (strlen($value) > $maxLength) {

        if ($pattern !== null && preg_match($pattern, $value) !== 1) {

            return $default;
        }

        if (!is_string($value) || !is_numeric($value)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                $this->invalidParameterMessage($key),

        }

        $integer = (int) $value;

        if ((string) $integer !== trim($value)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                $this->invalidParameterMessage($key),
            );
        }

        if ($integer < $minimum || $integer > $maximum) {
            if ($key === 'page') {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                    'The requested page is out of range.',

            throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                'Invalid ' . $this->parameterLabel($key)

    private function invalidParameterMessage(string $key): string
    {
        return 'Invalid ' . $this->parameterLabel($key) . ' parameter.';

    /**
     * Parses a comma-separated multi-value query parameter. Repeats the

     *
     * @return array<string>
     */
    private function paramList(
        Request $request,
        string $key,
        string $pattern,
        int $maxValues = CatalogSearchQuery::MAX_FILTER_VALUES,
    ): array {
        $value = $request->query($key);

        if ($value === null) {
            return [];
        }

        if (!is_string($value) || trim($value) === '') {
            if ($value === '') {
                return [];
            }

            throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                $this->invalidParameterMessage($key),
            );
        }

        $items = explode(',', $value);

        if (count($items) > $maxValues) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                'Too many ' . $this->parameterLabel($key)
                    . ' values were provided.',
            );
        }

        $normalized = [];

        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $item = trim($item);

            if ($item === '') {
                continue;
            }

            if (strlen($item) > 32 || preg_match($pattern, $item) !== 1) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                    $this->invalidParameterMessage($key),

            }

            $normalized[$item] = true;

        return array_keys($normalized);

    private function providerRegistry(

        return new ModpackProviderRegistry([
            new MockModpackProvider(),
            new ModrinthProvider(
                http: $http,
                downloader: $driver,
                temporaryRoot: self::TEMPORARY_ROOT,

                downloader: $driver,
                apiKey: $this->curseForgeApiKey(),
                temporaryRoot: self::TEMPORARY_ROOT,

    private function downloader(): DownloadManager
    {
        $maxMb = config('modpackinstaller.max_download_mb');

        if (is_numeric($maxMb) && (int) $maxMb > 0) {
            return new DownloadManager(
                self::TEMPORARY_ROOT,
                (int) $maxMb * 1024 * 1024,
            );
        }

        return new DownloadManager(self::TEMPORARY_ROOT);

    private function installProgressStore(): InstallProgressStore
    {
        return new InstallProgressStore(
            self::TEMPORARY_ROOT . '/progress',
        );
    }

    private function progressToken(Request $request): string
    {
        $token = $this->optionalProgressToken($request);

        if ($token === null) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                'A progress token is required.',
            );
        }

        return $token;
    }

    private function optionalProgressToken(
        Request $request,
    ): ?string {
        $value = $request->query('progress_token');

        if (!is_string($value) || trim($value) === '') {
            return null;
        }

        $token = trim($value);

        if (
            strlen($token) < 8
            || strlen($token) > 64
            || preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$/', $token) !== 1
        ) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                'The progress token is invalid.',
            );
        }

        return $token;
    }

    private function requestCancel(string $serverId): void
    {
        if (!is_dir(self::CANCEL_FLAG_DIR)) {
            if (

                && !is_dir(self::CANCEL_FLAG_DIR)
            ) {
                throw new RuntimeException(
                    'Unable to create the cancellation flag directory.'
                );
            }
        }

        $path = self::CANCEL_FLAG_DIR . '/' . $serverId;

        if (@file_put_contents($path, (string) time()) === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException(
                'Unable to write the cancellation flag.'
            );
        }
    }

    private function clearCancelFlag(string $serverId): void
    {
        @unlink(self::CANCEL_FLAG_DIR . '/' . $serverId);
    }

    private function wasCancelled(string $serverId): bool
    {
        return is_file(
            self::CANCEL_FLAG_DIR . '/' . $serverId,
        );
    }

    private function providerHttp(): ProviderHttpClient
    {
        return new CurlProviderHttpClient();
    }

    private function curseForgeApiKey(): ?string
    {
        $key = config('modpackinstaller.curseforge_api_key');

        if (!is_string($key) || $key === '') {
            return null;
        }

        return $key;
    }

    private function serverTarget(
        Server $server,
    ): ServerFileTarget {
        $selector = new ServerTargetSelector(
            mode: $this->targetMode(),
            localFactory: new ServerFileTargetFactory(

            wingsFactory: $this->wingsServerTargetFactory(),

    }

     * Removes the files a just-completed deployment created when the install
     * could not be recorded. Mirrors the orchestrator rollback for the new-file
     * case; previously existing files are left untouched.

    private function rollbackDeployedFiles(

199:      *   file_name: string, version: string, download_url: string|null, reason: string}
200:      */
201:     public function manualDownloadInfo(array $file, array $project): array
202:     {
203:         $logo = is_array($project['logo'] ?? null)
204:             ? $project['logo']
205:             : [];
206: 
207:         $icon = $this->nullableString($logo['thumbnailUrl'] ?? null)
208:             ?? $this->nullableString($logo['url'] ?? null);
209: 
210:         $projectUrl = $this->nullableString($project['links']['websiteUrl'] ?? null);
211: 
212:         $downloadUrl = $this->nullableString($file['downloadUrl'] ?? null);
213: 
214:         $version = $this->nullableString($file['displayName'] ?? null)
215:             ?? $this->nullableString($file['fileName'] ?? null);
216: 
217:         $reason = '';
218: 
219:         if ($downloadUrl === null) {
220:             $reason = 'This CurseForge modpack does not provide a public download URL. '
221:                 . 'Please download the file manually from '
222:                 . ($projectUrl ? $projectUrl : 'CurseForge.');
223:         } elseif (($file['isAvailable'] ?? true) === false) {
224:             $reason = 'This file is not available for download at this time.';
225:         } elseif (
226:             $this->intOrNull($file['fileStatus'] ?? null) !== null
227:             && !in_array($this->intOrNull($file['fileStatus'] ?? null), [4, 10], true)
228:         ) {
229:             $reason = 'This file is not publicly available for download.';
230:         } else {
231:             $reason = 'Unable to download this file automatically. '
232:                 . 'Please download manually from CurseForge.';
233:         }
234: 
235:         return [
236:             'provider' => 'curseforge',
237:             'project_name' => $this->nullableString($project['name'] ?? null) ?? '',
238:             'project_url' => $projectUrl,
239:             'file_name' => $this->nullableString($file['displayName'] ?? null)
240:                 ?? $this->nullableString($file['fileName'] ?? null),
241:             'version' => $version,
242:             'download_url' => $downloadUrl,
243:             'reason' => $reason,
244:         ];
245:     }

252:     /**
253:      * Resolves the file a source would install and, when that file cannot be
254:      * downloaded automatically, returns normalized manual-download guidance.
255:      * Returns null when the file can be installed automatically.
256:      *
257:      * @return array{
258:      *   provider: string,
259:      *   project_name: string,
260:      *   project_url: string|null,
261:      *   file_name: string,
262:      *   version: string,
263:      *   download_url: string|null,
264:      *   reason: string,
265:      * }|null
266:      */
267:     public function manualDownloadInfoFor(string $source): ?array
268:     {
269:         $parsed = $this->parseSource($source);
270: 
271:         if ($parsed === null) {
272:             throw new InvalidArgumentException(
273:                 'Unsupported modpack source.',
274:             );
275:         }
276: 
277:         $this->assertConfigured();
278: 
279:         $project = $this->fetchProject($parsed['projectId']);
280: 
281:         $this->assertModpackProject($project);
282: 
283:         $file = $this->resolveFile($parsed['projectId'], $parsed['fileId']);
284: 
285:         if ($file === null) {
286:             throw new InvalidArgumentException(
287:                 'The CurseForge project has no files.',
288:             );
289:         }
290: 
291:         $file = $this->resolvePackageFile($file, $parsed['projectId']);
292: 
293:         if ($this->isPubliclyDownloadable($file)) {
294:             return null;
295:         }
296: 
297:         return $this->manualDownloadInfo($file, $project);

313:     /**
314:      * Resolves a source string to a CurseForge project id and an optional
315:      * exact-file pin (curseforge://projectId@fileId). Returns null when the
316:      * syntax is unsupported.
317:      *
318:      * @return array{projectId: string, fileId: string|null}|null
319:      */
320:     private function parseSource(string $source): ?array
321:     {
322:         $source = trim($source);
323: 
324:         if (!str_starts_with($source, 'curseforge://')) {
325:             return null;
326:         }
327: 
328:         $rest = substr($source, strlen('curseforge://'));
329: 
330:         $pieces = explode('@', $rest, 2);
331: 
332:         $projectId = (string) ($pieces[0] ?? '');
333: 
334:         if (preg_match('/^\d+$/', $projectId) !== 1) {
335:             return null;
336:         }
337: 
338:         $fileId = null;
339: 
340:         if (isset($pieces[1])) {
341:             $fileId = trim((string) $pieces[1]);
342: 
343:             if ($fileId === '' || preg_match('/^\d+$/', $fileId) !== 1) {
344:                 return null;
345:             }
346:         }
347: 
348:         return [
349:             'projectId' => $projectId,
350:             'fileId' => $fileId,
351:         ];
352:     }

354:     private function canonicalSource(string $projectId, ?string $fileId): string
355:     {
356:         $source = 'curseforge://' . $projectId;
357: 
358:         if ($fileId !== null) {
359:             return $source . '@' . $fileId;
360:         }
361: 
362:         return $source;
363:     }

365:     /**
366:      * Selects a file for the project: the exact pinned file when a pin is
367:      * present, otherwise the newest Release file (falling back to the newest
368:      * file).
369:      *
370:      * @return array<string, mixed>
371:      */
372:     private function resolveFile(string $projectId, ?string $fileId): array
373:     {
374:         if ($fileId !== null) {
375:             $file = $this->fetchFileById($projectId, $fileId);
376: 
377:             $this->assertFileBelongsToProject($file, $projectId);
378: 
379:             return $file;
380:         }
381: 
382:         $files = $this->fetchFiles($projectId);
383: 
384:         $file = $this->selectFile($files);
385: 
386:         if ($file === null) {
387:             throw new InvalidArgumentException(
388:                 'The CurseForge project has no files.',
389:             );
390:         }
391: 
392:         return $file;
393:     }

395:     /**
396:      * Prefers a dedicated server pack when the selected file references one,
397:      * falling back to the selected file when the server pack cannot be
398:      * resolved to a public download.
399:      *
400:      * @param array<string, mixed> $file
401:      *
402:      * @return array<string, mixed>
403:      */
404:     private function resolvePackageFile(array $file, string $projectId): array
405:     {
406:         $serverPackFileId = $this->intOrNull(
407:             $file['serverPackFileId'] ?? null,
408:         );
409: 
410:         if ($serverPackFileId === null || $serverPackFileId <= 0) {
411:             return $file;
412:         }
413: 
414:         $serverPack = $this->fetchServerPackFile(
415:             $projectId,
416:             (string) $serverPackFileId,
417:         );
418: 
419:         if ($serverPack === null) {
420:             return $file;
421:         }
422: 
423:         return $serverPack;
424:     }

426:     /**
427:      * Whether a file is installable: public status (or unspecified), marked
428:      * available (or unspecified), with a public download URL.
429:      *
430:      * @param array<string, mixed> $file
431:      */
432:     private function isPubliclyDownloadable(array $file): bool
433:     {
434:         $status = $this->intOrNull($file['fileStatus'] ?? null);
435: 
436:         if ($status !== null && !in_array($status, [4, 10], true)) {
437:             return false;
438:         }
439: 
440:         if (($file['isAvailable'] ?? true) === false) {
441:             return false;
442:         }
443: 
444:         return $this->nullableString($file['downloadUrl'] ?? null) !== null;
445:     }

447:     /**
448:      * Fetches the dedicated server pack file referenced by a file. Returns
449:      * null when it no longer exists (404) or has no public download URL so the
450:      * caller can fall back to the selected file.
451:      *
452:      * @return array<string, mixed>|null
453:      */
454:     private function fetchServerPackFile(
455:         string $projectId,
456:         string $fileId,
457:     ): ?array {
458:         try {
459:             $response = $this->http->get(
460:                 self::API_BASE . '/mods/' . $projectId . '/files/' . $fileId,
461:                 headers: $this->headers(),
462:             );
463: 
464:             if (
465:                 !is_array($response->body)
466:                 || !is_array($response->body['data'] ?? null)
467:             ) {
468:                 throw new InvalidArgumentException(
469:                     'The CurseForge file was invalid.',
470:                 );
471:             }
472: 
473:             $file = $response->body['data'];
474:         } catch (ProviderHttpException $exception) {
475:             if ($exception->status() === 404) {
476:                 return null;
477:             }
478: 
479:             throw $this->requestFailure($exception);
480:         }
481: 
482:         $this->assertFileBelongsToProject($file, $projectId);
483: 
484:         if (!$this->isPubliclyDownloadable($file)) {
485:             return null;
486:         }
487: 
488:         return $file;
489:     }

491:     /**
492:      * Prevents a client-supplied file id from referencing a file that belongs
493:      * to a different project. A file payload without a mod id is tolerated so
494:      * providers without the field keep working, but any id that is present
495:      * must match the requested project.

499:     private function assertFileBelongsToProject(
500:         array $file,
501:         string $projectId,
502:     ): void {

505:         if ($modId === null) {
506:             return;
507:         }
508: 
509:         if ((string) $modId !== $projectId) {
510:             throw new InvalidArgumentException(
511:                 'The requested file does not belong to the selected project.',
512:             );
513:         }
514:     }

649:     /**
650:      * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $files
651:      *
652:      * @return array<string, mixed>|null
653:      */
654:     private function selectFile(array $files): ?array
655:     {
656:         if ($files === []) {
657:             return null;
658:         }
659: 
660:         $sorted = $files;
661: 
662:         usort($sorted, static function (array $a, array $b): int {
663:             $aTime = strtotime((string) ($a['fileDate'] ?? ''));
664:             $bTime = strtotime((string) ($b['fileDate'] ?? ''));
665: 
666:             return $bTime <=> $aTime;
667:         });
668: 
669:         foreach ($sorted as $file) {
670:             if ((int) ($file['releaseType'] ?? 0) === 1) {
671:                 return $file;
672:             }
673:         }
674: 
675:         return $sorted[0];
676:     }

678:     /**
679:      * @param array<mixed> $gameVersions
680:      *
681:      * @return array{0: string|null, 1: string|null} [minecraft, loader]
682:      */
683:     private function parseGameVersions(array $gameVersions): array
684:     {
685:         $loaderNames = [
686:             'Forge',
687:             'Fabric',
688:             'Quilt',
689:             'NeoForge',
690:             'LiteLoader',
691:             'Rift',
692:         ];
693: 
694:         $minecraftVersion = null;
695:         $loader = null;
696: 
697:         foreach ($gameVersions as $entry) {
698:             if (!is_string($entry)) {
699:                 continue;
700:             }
701: 
702:             if (in_array($entry, $loaderNames, true)) {
703:                 if ($loader === null) {
704:                     $loader = $entry;
705:                 }
706: 
707:                 continue;
708:             }
709: 
710:             if (
711:                 $minecraftVersion === null
712:                 && preg_match('/^\d+\.\d+(\.\d+)*$/', $entry) === 1
713:             ) {
714:                 $minecraftVersion = $entry;
715:             }
716:         }
717: 
718:         return [$minecraftVersion, $loader];
719:     }

721:     /**
722:      * Returns a normalized server archive for the downloaded CurseForge file.
723:      * Dedicated server packs do not carry manifest.json and pass through
724:      * untouched (null). Client packs are rebuilt from their manifest: every
725:      * required, server-compatible mod file is downloaded into mods/ and the
726:      * overrides directory is applied at the archive root.
727:      *
728:      * Malformed or unresolvable manifests fail loudly (never silently skip) so
729:      * a partial install is never reported as complete.
730:      */
731:     private function manifestResolvedArchive(string $archivePath): ?string
732:     {
733:         $source = new ZipArchive();
734: 
735:         if ($source->open($archivePath) !== true) {
736:             throw new InvalidArgumentException(
737:                 'The downloaded CurseForge file is not a valid archive.',
738:             );
739:         }
740: 
741:         try {
742:             if ($source->statName(self::MANIFEST_FILE) === false) {
743:                 return null;
744:             }
745: 
746:             $rawManifest = $source->getFromName(self::MANIFEST_FILE);
747: 
748:             if ($rawManifest === false) {
749:                 throw new UnsupportedModpackPackageException(
750:                     'The CurseForge modpack manifest could not be read.',
751:                 );
752:             }
753: 
754:             $manifest = json_decode($rawManifest, true);
755: 
756:             if (!is_array($manifest)) {
757:                 throw new UnsupportedModpackPackageException(
758:                     'The CurseForge modpack contains a malformed manifest.json client-pack manifest.',
759:                 );
760:             }
761: 
762:             return $this->buildServerArchive($source, $archivePath, $manifest);
763:         } finally {
764:             $source->close();
765:         }
766:     }
767: 
768:     /**
769:      * Rebuilds a CurseForge client pack into a normalized server archive.
770:      *
771:      * @param array<string, array{archiveEntry: string|null, downloadUrls: array<int, string>, priority: string, bytes: int}> $content
772:      */
773:     private function buildServerArchive(
774:         ZipArchive $source,
775:         string $archivePath,
776:         array $manifest,
777:     ): string {
778:         $content = $this->collectArchiveContent(
779:             $source,
780:             $this->manifestOverridesPath($manifest),
781:         );
782: 
783:         [$installedMods, $wantedMods] = $this->mergeManifestFiles(
784:             $manifest,
785:             $content,
786:         );
787: 
788:         if ($content === []) {
789:             throw new UnsupportedModpackPackageException(
790:                 'The CurseForge modpack contains no server content to install (no mods or overrides).',
791:             );
792:         }
793: 
794:         if ($wantedMods > 0 && $installedMods === 0) {
795:             throw new UnsupportedModpackPackageException(
796:                 'The CurseForge modpack references mod files with no usable download source, so no server mods could be installed.',
797:             );
798:         }
799: 
800:         // Re-anchor cumulative progress on the whole network footprint: the
801:         // downloaded client-pack bytes plus every manifest mod file still to
802:         // fetch. Offsets only ever grow, so the bar moves forward without
803:         // resetting between the per-mod downloads.
804:         $archiveBytes = max(0, (int) @filesize($archivePath));
805: 
806:         foreach ($content as $payload) {
807:             if ($payload['archiveEntry'] === null) {
808:                 $archiveBytes += max(0, (int) $payload['bytes']);
809:             }
810:         }
811: 
812:         $networkBytesDone = max(0, (int) @filesize($archivePath));
813: 
814:         $this->downloader->setProgressOffset(
815:             $networkBytesDone,
816:             max($networkBytesDone, $archiveBytes),
817:         );
818: 
819:         $root = rtrim($this->temporaryRoot, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR);
820: 
821:         if (
822:             !is_dir($root)
823:             && !mkdir($root, 0750, true)
824:             && !is_dir($root)
825:         ) {
826:             throw new RuntimeException(
827:                 'Unable to create the temporary package directory.',
828:             );
829:         }
830: 
831:         $outputPath = $root . '/' . bin2hex(random_bytes(16)) . '.zip';
832: 
833:         $output = new ZipArchive();
834: 
835:         if ($output->open($outputPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE) !== true) {
836:             throw new RuntimeException(
837:                 'Unable to create the normalized package archive.',
838:             );
839:         }
840: 
841:         $scratchPaths = [];
842:         $downloadedTemps = [];
843: 
844:         $downloadedMods = 0;
845: 
846:         try {
847:             foreach ($content as $relative => $payload) {
848:                 if ($this->downloader->isCancelled()) {
849:                     throw new InstallationCancelledException(
850:                         'Installation cancelled.'
851:                     );
852:                 }
853: 
854:                 $stream = null;
855:                 $scratch = null;
856: 
857:                 try {
858:                     if ($payload['archiveEntry'] !== null) {
859:                         $stream = $source->getStream(
860:                             $payload['archiveEntry'],
861:                         );
862: 
863:                         if ($stream === false) {
864:                             throw new RuntimeException(
865:                                 'Unable to read an entry from the modpack archive.',
866:                             );
867:                         }
868:                     } else {
869:                         $downloadPath = $this->downloadBestUrl(
870:                             $payload['downloadUrls'],
871:                             $networkBytesDone,
872:                             $archiveBytes,
873:                         );
874: 
875:                         if ($downloadPath === null) {
876:                             continue;
877:                         }
878: 
879:                         $downloadedMods++;
880: 
881:                         $downloadedTemps[] = $downloadPath;
882: 
883:                         $networkBytesDone += max(
884:                             0,
885:                             (int) $payload['bytes'],
886:                         );
887: 
888:                         $stream = @fopen($downloadPath, 'rb');
889: 
890:                         if ($stream === false) {
891:                             throw new RuntimeException(
892:                                 'Unable to read a downloaded modpack file.',
893:                             );
894:                         }
895:                     }
896: 
897:                     $scratchPath = $root
898:                         . '/'
899:                         . bin2hex(random_bytes(16))
900:                         . '.bin';
901: 
902:                     $scratch = @fopen($scratchPath, 'wb');
903: 
904:                     if ($scratch === false) {
905:                         throw new RuntimeException(
906:                             'Unable to create a scratch file for the normalized archive.',
907:                         );
908:                     }
909: 
910:                     if (stream_copy_to_stream($stream, $scratch) === false) {
911:                         throw new RuntimeException(
912:                             'Unable to copy a modpack file into the normalized archive.',
913:                         );
914:                     }
915: 
916:                     $scratchPaths[] = $scratchPath;
917: 
918:                     if ($output->addFile($scratchPath, $relative) === false) {
919:                         throw new RuntimeException(
920:                             'Unable to add a modpack file to the normalized archive.',
921:                         );
922:                     }
923:                 } finally {
924:                     if ($scratch !== null) {
925:                         fclose($scratch);
926:                     }
927: 
928:                     if ($stream !== null) {
929:                         fclose($stream);
930:                     }
931:                 }
932:             }
933: 
934:             if ($wantedMods > 0 && $downloadedMods === 0) {
935:                 throw new UnsupportedModpackPackageException(
936:                     'None of the CurseForge mod files referenced by the modpack could be downloaded, so no server mods could be installed.',
937:                 );
938:             }
939:         } finally {
940:             $output->close();
941: 
942:             foreach ($scratchPaths as $scratchPath) {
943:                 @unlink($scratchPath);
944:             }
945: 
946:             foreach ($downloadedTemps as $downloadPath) {
947:                 @unlink($downloadPath);
948:             }
949:         }
950: 
951:         return $outputPath;
952:     }

954:     /**
955:      * Collects the overrides payload embedded in the client-pack archive
956:      * itself, dropping the configured overrides directory prefix so it lands
957:      * at the server root.
958:      *
959:      * @return array<string, array{archiveEntry: string, downloadUrls: array<int, string>, priority: string, bytes: int}>
960:      */
961:     private function collectArchiveContent(
962:         ZipArchive $source,
963:         string $overridesPath,
964:     ): array {
965:         $content = [];
966:         $prefix = $overridesPath . '/';
967: 
968:         for ($index = 0; $index < $source->numFiles; $index++) {
969:             $entry = $source->statIndex($index);
970: 
971:             if ($entry === false) {
972:                 throw new UnsupportedModpackPackageException(
973:                     'The modpack archive contains an unreadable entry.',
974:                 );
975:             }
976: 
977:             $name = (string) ($entry['name'] ?? '');
978: 
979:             if ($name === '' || str_ends_with($name, '/')) {
980:                 continue;
981:             }
982: 
983:             if (!str_starts_with($name, $prefix)) {
984:                 continue;
985:             }
986: 
987:             $relative = substr($name, strlen($prefix));
988: 
989:             if ($relative === '' || !$this->isSafeRelativePath($relative)) {
990:                 throw new InvalidArgumentException(
991:                     'The modpack archive contains an invalid entry path.',
992:                 );
993:             }
994: 
995:             $content[$relative] = [
996:                 'archiveEntry' => $name,
997:                 'downloadUrls' => [],
998:                 'priority' => 'overrides',
999:                 'bytes' => 0,
1000:             ];
1001:         }
1002: 
1003:         return $content;
1004:     }
1005: 
1006:     /**
1007:      * Resolves manifest mod files through the CurseForge API and merges the
1008:      * resolvable ones into the normalized archive under mods/. Each mod file
1009:      * is attached to an ordered list of candidate download URLs so a file the
1010:      * bulk API reports without a download URL can still be pulled from the
1011:      * CurseForge CDN layout. Files that individually fail every candidate at
1012:      * download time are skipped with a diagnostic (never silently): the
1013:      * official CurseForge flow keeps installing the rest of a pack when a few
1014:      * mod files have died upstream. Only when no manifest mod file can be
1015:      * installed does the caller abort.
1016:      *
1017:      * @return array{0: int, 1: int} [installed count, wanted count]
1018:      */
1019:     private function mergeManifestFiles(array $manifest, array &$content): array
1020:     {
1021:         $entries = $manifest['files'] ?? [];
1022: 
1023:         if (!is_array($entries)) {
1024:             throw new UnsupportedModpackPackageException(
1025:                 'The CurseForge modpack contains an invalid manifest.json files list.',
1026:             );
1027:         }
1028: 
1029:         $wanted = [];
1030: 
1031:         foreach ($entries as $entry) {
1032:             if (!is_array($entry)) {
1033:                 throw new UnsupportedModpackPackageException(
1034:                     'The CurseForge modpack contains an invalid manifest.json file entry.',
1035:                 );
1036:             }
1037: 
1038:             if (($entry['required'] ?? true) === false) {
1039:                 continue;
1040:             }
1041: 
1042:             $env = is_array($entry['env'] ?? null) ? $entry['env'] : [];
1043: 
1044:             if (($env['server'] ?? 'required') === 'unsupported') {
1045:                 continue;
1046:             }
1047: 
1048:             $projectId = $this->intOrNull($entry['projectID'] ?? null);
1049:             $fileId = $this->intOrNull($entry['fileID'] ?? null);
1050: 
1051:             if ($projectId === null || $fileId === null) {
1052:                 throw new UnsupportedModpackPackageException(
1053:                     'The CurseForge modpack manifest references a file without a project and file id.',
1054:                 );
1055:             }
1056: 
1057:             $wanted[$fileId] = [
1058:                 'projectId' => $projectId,
1059:             ];
1060:         }
1061: 
1062:         $resolved = $this->fetchModFiles(array_keys($wanted));
1063: 
1064:         $installed = 0;
1065:         $skipped = 0;
1066: 
1067:         foreach ($wanted as $fileId => $meta) {
1068:             $file = $resolved[$fileId] ?? null;
1069:             $fileName = $this->manifestFileName($file, (int) $fileId);
1070: 
1071:             $candidates = $this->candidateDownloadUrls(
1072:                 (string) $meta['projectId'],
1073:                 (int) $fileId,
1074:                 $file,
1075:                 $fileName,
1076:             );
1077: 
1078:             if ($candidates === []) {
1079:                 $skipped++;
1080:                 $this->recordManifestSkip((int) $fileId);
1081: 
1082:                 continue;
1083:             }
1084: 
1085:             $relative = 'mods/' . $fileName;
1086: 
1087:             if ($this->shouldReplace($content[$relative] ?? null, 'mods')) {
1088:                 $content[$relative] = [
1089:                     'archiveEntry' => null,
1090:                     'downloadUrls' => $candidates,
1091:                     'priority' => 'mods',
1092:                     'bytes' => max(0, (int) ($file['fileLength'] ?? 0)),
1093:                 ];
1094:             }
1095: 
1096:             $installed++;
1097:         }
1098: 
1099:         if ($skipped > 0) {
1100:             @error_log(
1101:                 'modpackinstaller manifest resolution skipped '
1102:                 . $skipped
1103:                 . ' of '
1104:                 . count($wanted)
1105:                 . ' mod files without any usable download source.'
1106:             );
1107:         }
1108: 
1109:         return [$installed, count($wanted)];
1110:     }
1111: 
1112:     private function recordManifestSkip(int $fileId): void
1113:     {
1114:         @error_log(
1115:             'modpackinstaller manifest resolution skipped mod file '
1116:             . $fileId
1117:             . ' (no usable download source on CurseForge).'
1118:         );
1119:     }
1120: 
1121:     /**
1122:      * Resolves a list of CurseForge file ids through the bulk files endpoint
1123:      * (chunked to the API's 50-per-request cap).
1124:      *
1125:      * @param array<int> $fileIds
1126:      *
1127:      * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
1128:      */
1129:     private function fetchModFiles(array $fileIds): array
1130:     {
1131:         $resolved = [];
1132: 
1133:         foreach (array_chunk(array_values(array_unique($fileIds)), 50) as $chunk) {
1134:             try {
1135:                 $response = $this->http->post(
1136:                     self::API_BASE . '/mods/files',
1137:                     body: ['fileIds' => $chunk],
1138:                     headers: $this->headers(),
1139:                 );
1140:             } catch (ProviderHttpException $exception) {
1141:                 throw $this->requestFailure($exception);
1142:             }
1143: 
1144:             if (
1145:                 !is_array($response->body)
1146:                 || !is_array($response->body['data'] ?? null)
1147:             ) {
1148:                 throw new RuntimeException(
1149:                     'The CurseForge mod file resolution response was invalid.',
1150:                 );
1151:             }
1152: 
1153:             foreach ($response->body['data'] as $file) {
1154:                 if (!is_array($file)) {
1155:                     throw new RuntimeException(
1156:                         'The CurseForge mod file resolution response was invalid.',
1157:                     );
1158:                 }
1159: 
1160:                 $id = $this->intOrNull($file['id'] ?? null);
1161: 
1162:                 if ($id === null) {
1163:                     continue;
1164:                 }
1165: 
1166:                 $resolved[$id] = $file;
1167:             }
1168:         }
1169:

1171:     }

1173:     /**
1174:      * Derives the mods/ file name for a manifest file, falling back to the
1175:      * file id when the API reports no usable file name.
1176:      *
1177:      * @param array<string, mixed>|null $file
1178:      */
1179:     private function manifestFileName(?array $file, int $fileId): string
1180:     {
1181:         $name = str_replace('\\', '/', (string) ($file['fileName'] ?? ''));
1182: 
1183:         $name = basename($name);
1184: 
1185:         if ($name === '' || !$this->isSafeRelativePath($name)) {
1186:             $name = (string) $fileId;
1187:         }
1188: 
1189:         return $name;
1190:     }
1191: 
1192:     /**
1193:      * Builds an ordered list of candidate download URLs for a manifest mod
1194:      * file. The metadata download URL is preferred, then the dedicated
1195:      * download-url endpoint is consulted for files that serve none, and the
1196:      * URL reconstructed from the CurseForge CDN layout
1197:      * (edge.forgecdn.net/files/{id/1000}/{id%1000}/{name}) is always kept as
1198:      * a last resort so files the API reports without a download URL can still
1199:      * be fetched.
1200:      *
1201:      * @param array<string, mixed>|null $file
1202:      *
1203:      * @return list<string>
1204:      */
1205:     private function candidateDownloadUrls(
1206:         string $projectId,
1207:         int $fileId,
1208:         ?array $file,
1209:         string $fileName,
1210:     ): array {
1211:         $candidates = [];
1212: 
1213:         $downloadUrl = $this->nullableString($file['downloadUrl'] ?? null);
1214: 
1215:         if ($downloadUrl !== null) {
1216:             $candidates[] = $downloadUrl;
1217:         } elseif ($projectId !== '') {
1218:             $resolvedUrl = $this->resolveDownloadUrl($projectId, (string) $fileId);
1219: 
1220:             if ($resolvedUrl !== null) {
1221:                 $candidates[] = $resolvedUrl;
1222:             }
1223:         }
1224: 
1225:         $candidates[] = $this->cdnDownloadUrl($fileId, $fileName);
1226: 
1227:         return array_values(array_unique($candidates));
1228:     }
1229: 
1230:     /**
1231:      * Asks the CurseForge download-url endpoint for a live download URL for a
1232:      * specific file. Returns null when the API rejects the request or serves
1233:      * no URL so the caller can fall back to the reconstructed CDN URL.
1234:      */
1235:     private function resolveDownloadUrl(string $projectId, string $fileId): ?string
1236:     {
1237:         try {
1238:             $response = $this->http->get(
1239:                 self::API_BASE
1240:                     . '/mods/'
1241:                     . $projectId
1242:                     . '/files/'
1243:                     . $fileId
1244:                     . '/download-url',
1245:                 headers: $this->headers(),
1246:             );
1247:         } catch (Throwable $exception) {
1248:             if ($exception instanceof InstallationCancelledException) {
1249:                 throw $exception;
1250:             }
1251: 
1252:             return null;
1253:         }
1254: 
1255:         return $this->nullableString($response->body['data'] ?? null);
1256:     }
1257: 
1258:     /**
1259:      * Reconstructs the direct CurseForge CDN URL for a file id and name. The
1260:      * CDN can serve files even when the API metadata omits its download URL.
1261:      */
1262:     private function cdnDownloadUrl(int $fileId, string $fileName): string
1263:     {
1264:         return self::CDN_BASE
1265:             . '/'
1266:             . intdiv($fileId, 1000)
1267:             . '/'
1268:             . ($fileId % 1000)
1269:             . '/'
1270:             . rawurlencode($fileName);
1271:     }
1272: 
1273:     /**
1274:      * Attempts each candidate download URL in order until one succeeds and
1275:      * returns its destination path, or null when every candidate fails.
1276:      *
1277:      * @param non-empty-list<string> $candidates
1278:      */
1279:     private function downloadBestUrl(
1280:         array $candidates,
1281:         int &$networkBytesDone,
1282:         int $archiveBytes,
1283:     ): ?string {
1284:         foreach ($candidates as $candidate) {
1285:             $this->downloader->setProgressOffset(
1286:                 $networkBytesDone,
1287:                 max($networkBytesDone, $archiveBytes),
1288:             );
1289: 
1290:             try {
1291:                 return $this->downloader->download($candidate);
1292:             } catch (InvalidArgumentException | RuntimeException $exception) {
1293:                 if ($exception instanceof InstallationCancelledException) {
1294:                     throw $exception;
1295:                 }
1296: 
1297:                 if ($this->downloader->isCancelled()) {
1298:                     throw new InstallationCancelledException(
1299:                         'Installation cancelled.'
1300:                     );
1301:                 }
1302:             }
1303:         }
1304: 
1305:         return null;
1306:     }

1308:     private function manifestOverridesPath(array $manifest): string
1309:     {
1310:         $overrides = (string) ($manifest['overrides'] ?? '');
1311:         $overrides = $overrides === ''

1316:             throw new UnsupportedModpackPackageException(

1318:             );

1321:         return $overrides;
1322:     }
